parsed.explanation: The dossier shows a hostile state regime rather than merely absent recognition. The 2026 amendment expressly bans promotion/financing/support of transsexuality and raises penalties for conduct under Art. 319 to 5-10 years (and up to 20 for some arrests), while the state rejected decriminalisation and anti-LGBT protection. Enforcement is documented: police arrest on reports/video circulation, a border-post detention, mass arrests, convictions, custody abuse allegations, and severe social violence including desecration of 'man-woman' corpses. Local trans groups are low-profile and coverage is a floor, so unknown trans-specific border/facility rules do not imply safety. No offsetting visitor protections: no effective recourse, no anti-discrimination enforcement, weak rule-of-law relief. Uncertainty remains over whether the transsexuality provision is applied to travelers or only advocacy, but discovery carries high-severity arrest/prison/violence. Thus High Risk, above execution/registry regimes.
